name: Malformed Deny condition suppresses a real Allow finding (fail-open, both effects)
note: S1-shape-failclosed regression. Condition-shape malformation is NOT only an Allow problem: statement 0 is a real DATA-EXFIL-class Allow (s3:GetObject on data/*), and statement 1 is a Deny of the same action/resource whose Condition operator block is a bare string. AWS rejects the block, and the engine drops it and reads the Deny as UNCONDITIONAL, which SUPPRESSES the Allow finding - leaving a silent CLEAN. An Allow-only masked-grant detector would miss this. Condition-shape detection must run on the Deny too, so the shared engine marks coverage INCOMPLETE (MALFORMED_CONDITION_BLOCK) and neither surface reports a clean pass.
